captions.detailed: This 3D model is an angled drill bit or tool holder designed for mounting. It consists of a long rectangular base block featuring small vertical alignment notches on its ends and sides. Emerging from the center of this base is an angled square column containing a deep, cylindrical bore down its center axis to hold a bit of a specific diameter.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric angled tool bit holder in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the bit diameter and the angle of the holder relative to the base. Ensure the base has small alignment notches on the sides for positioning.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a main module `holder(diameter, angle)`. The base is created with a `cube` of size [15, 60, 15] translated to center it, which has vertical `notch` shapes subtracted from its ends using `difference`. The angled portion is a second `cube` rotated by `[90-angle, 0, 0]`, which is unioned with the base. A cylindrical bore is subtracted along the same rotated axis using `cylinder`. Finally, additional alignment notches (rotated cubes) are subtracted from the sides of the assembly.
